endpoints.state_rule: STUCK := hit_eval < 0.2; GOOD := RECOVERED or (hit_eval > 0.8 and backlog slope <= 0.5 (lambda - lambda_ref)); state stuck | good | neither
endpoints.cell_call: per mode over exact seeds 0-2: TRAPS (STUCK >= 2 of 3) | NO-TRAP (GOOD >= 2 of 3) | MIXED

exploratory_definitions.out_2100_2400: mean outstanding requests (waiting + running + gate) over the 10-s tick samples in [2100, 2400)
exploratory_definitions.alive_T: sessions in the system (arrived, not finished, incl. gate) at the T-s tick
exploratory_definitions.t_fu150: start of the first 150-s window [1200 + 150k, +150) with follow-up hit < 0.5

sensitivity.note: NOT predictions: exact-plan calls of the prediction cells when one input is changed, (a) the slowdown's add_s at the cell's window and rate, (b) the engine speed (every iteration cost of the calibrated engine block scaled by f; f < 1 = faster engine)
